overall_vote.description: Is the document sound as written?

findings.description: Every objection. An empty array is a valid and meaningful answer.

section.description: The section number or heading the finding is against. A finding that cannot name one is downgraded to minor, because an objection that does not attach to text cannot be acted on.

severity.description: fatal: the document cannot proceed as written. major: a stated conclusion would be wrong or unsupported. minor: it would be better changed. Anything at major or above must state what would fix it or it is downgraded.

what_would_fix_it.description: Required for fatal and major. A finding at those levels with null here is downgraded to minor by the adjudication rule.

quote.description: Verbatim text from the document the finding is against, or from a cited source that contradicts it. Optional, and it is what distinguishes an evidenced objection from an opinion.
